name: plant-pact
description: Forecast how long a gifted houseplant survives in a specific friend's flat using live Open-Meteo weather, ERA5 climate normals and a trained survival model, then collect the real outcome 90 days later.

auth.note: Tools are scoped to the caller's anonymous HTTP-only session cookie, which is the same ownership boundary the web UI uses. There are no accounts and no API keys. A client should send the cookie it receives from GET / for subsequent calls; a client without a cookie gets its own empty session.

tools.name: score_placement
tools.description: Run the deterministic survival model against live weather for a candidate placement. Writes nothing.

tools.name: commit_pact
tools.description: Persist a placement as a pact, score it and seal the creation event. Accepts idempotencyKey; a replayed key returns the original pact with created=false.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Record whether the plant survived, struggled or died, and close the pact.

tools.name: delete_pact
tools.description: Tombstone a pact. The row stops appearing in reads but its audit chain is retained and replayable.

tools.name: get_pact
tools.description: Read one pact with its species profile, audit events, a freshly computed verdict and the chain replay.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Normalized 14-day forecast plus 12 monthly ERA5 climate normals, labelled live or sealed.

tools.name: match_species
tools.description: Resolve any plant name against the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy.

tools.name: verify_integrity
tools.description: Replay a pact's SHA-384 seal chain and report the first broken sequence.

integrity.canonicalJson: recursively key-sorted, array order preserved, UTF-8
